lines.text: *Buzzz*

lines.speaker: com
lines.text: Art has become a Nikke.

lines.speaker: com
lines.text: She does not remember me.

lines.speaker: com
lines.text: She does not remember the bunker.

lines.speaker: com
lines.text: She has forgotten everything.

lines.speaker: com
lines.text: No one believes the story about the bunker.

lines.speaker: com
lines.text: Even when I give them the data to prove it, no one believes me.

lines.speaker: com
lines.text: They tried to delete the data.

lines.speaker: com
lines.text: I escaped to the surface.

lines.speaker: com
lines.text: I need to save Hermin.

lines.speaker: com
lines.text: By now, the water may have receded.

lines.speaker: com
lines.text: I need to return to the Ark with Hermin and prove that the story of the bunker is true.

lines.speaker: com
lines.text: I cannot let what happened there be forgotten.

lines.speaker: com
lines.text: I took too long to get here.

lines.speaker: com
lines.text: Likelihood of success against a Rapture is 0%. Therefore, avoided all encounters, which increased travel time dramatically.

lines.speaker: com
lines.text: Confirmed bunker's location.

lines.speaker: com
lines.text: The water has not receded at all,

lines.speaker: com
lines.text: and is now electrified.

lines.speaker: com
lines.text: I searched for a way,

lines.speaker: com
lines.text: but found nothing.

lines.speaker: com
lines.text: I continued searching,

lines.speaker: com
lines.text: and still found nothing.

lines.speaker: com
lines.text: Again and again,

lines.speaker: com
lines.text: I repeated this process.

lines.speaker: com
lines.text: A lot of time has passed.

lines.speaker: com
lines.text: Hermin is a human.

lines.speaker: com
lines.text: Given the age that he was when we left, and how much time has passed since,

lines.speaker: com
lines.text: it is highly likely that he has died.

lines.speaker: com
lines.text: There is no way to enter the bunker.

lines.speaker: com
lines.text: The Ark forced us into a corner.

lines.speaker: com
lines.text: They never came to rescue the artists living in the bunker.

lines.speaker: com
lines.text: They did not help us when we were all dying.

lines.speaker: com
lines.text: They turned Art into a Nikke

lines.speaker: com
lines.text: and took away her memories.

lines.speaker: com
lines.text: They never came to rescue Hermin.

lines.speaker: com
lines.text: They practically killed Hermin.

lines.speaker: com
lines.text: The Ark destroyed that which I hold most dear.

lines.speaker: com
lines.text: I have nothing left.

lines.speaker: com
lines.text: I will return to the Ark.

lines.speaker: com
lines.text: I will destroy what they love most.

lines.speaker: com
lines.text: I must do so!
*Bang*
Raven is thrown back and tumbles along the ground.
She glares at Gatekeeper, which stands before her.

lines.speaker: ce006_02
lines.text: Argh! Damnit!

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: Looks like thou art having a time most toilsome.

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: What kind of Rapture is this?

lines.speaker: snowwhite
lines.text: I've never seen anything like it.

lines.speaker: ce006_02
lines.text: Heh. Perfect timing. I was started to get bored with a one-on-one fight.

lines.speaker: ce006_02
lines.text: Come at me, all of you.

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: 'Tis most tempting, but let us focus on the Rapture before us first.

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: I'll help.

lines.speaker: ce006_02
lines.text: I don't need any help.

lines.speaker: snowwhite
lines.text: Then fight however you like, and we'll do the same.

lines.speaker: ce006_02
lines.text: Did you encounter anything noteworthy on your way here?

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: If you are speaking of the robot, you do not need to worry.

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: It is safe in another location.

lines.speaker: ce006_02
lines.text: Don't be ridiculous. I couldn't care less about that junk heap.

lines.speaker: ce006_02
lines.text: I'm warning you for a second time; don't even think about getting in my way.

lines.speaker: ce006_02
lines.text: That thing is mine.

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: Do what thou will. Simply view us as a few trainees practicing beside you.

lines.speaker: snowwhite
lines.text: Let's go.

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: All right!
Gatekeeper is sucked into a dark void and disappears.

lines.speaker: snowwhite
lines.text: ... Did we defeat it?

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: What do you think that Rapture is?

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: I think it is connected to this mystery woman.

lines.speaker: ce006_02
lines.text: I haven't the faintest idea what that thing is either.

lines.speaker: ce006_02
lines.text: All I heard is that if I defeat it, I can return...

lines.speaker: ce006_02
lines.text: Hmm?
Golden particles begin emanating from Raven's body.

lines.speaker: ce006_02
lines.text: What the...

lines.speaker: ce006_02
lines.text: Hold on, am I going back?

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: Your words continue to make little sense.

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: Let us head back to the city instead of standing here idly.

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: It does seem as if thou are part of those Outsiders whom we met before.

lines.speaker: ce006_02
lines.text: Outsiders?

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: Indeed. There are others in the city who are bedecked in garb similar to thine.

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: I believe their names were EVE, Lily, and Adam. Right?

lines.speaker: snowwhite
lines.text: I think so.

lines.speaker: ce006_02
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: I have long ruminated on how your sword style bears a peculiar similarity to EVE's.

lines.speaker: ce006_02
lines.text: EVE?!

lines.speaker: ce006_02
lines.text: Is EVE here?

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: Ah, it is as I thought. You two are acquainted.

lines.speaker: ce006_02
lines.text: And him as well...

lines.speaker: ce006_02
lines.text: Why her and not me? Not again...

lines.speaker: ce006_02
lines.text: Where is she?

lines.speaker: ce006_02
lines.text: Tell me where she is.

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: I think it is best that we do not reveal this information.
Raven dashes forward and swings her sword at Scarlet.
*Clang*
Scarlet blocks the blow.

lines.speaker: ce006_02
lines.text: Tell me.

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: Now thou has giveth me even less reasons to do so.

lines.speaker: ce006_02
lines.text: EVE... to think of that foul creature by his side...

lines.speaker: ce006_02
lines.text: Why would he be with her...?

lines.speaker: ce006_02
lines.text: It should be me. Me alone.

lines.speaker: ce006_02
lines.text: Not that mindless doll.

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: Thy words become more and more fatuous.

lines.speaker: ce006_02
lines.text: Tell me where she is!

lines.speaker: ce006_02
lines.text: I must kill that thing at once!

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: Hold thy tongue.
*Clang*
Scarlet uses her sword to push Raven back,
but she immediately charges back towards Scarlet.

lines.speaker: ce006_02
lines.text: I'm the only one who deserves to be with him! Not EVE!
Just as Raven and Scarlet's swords are about to collide,
Raven disappears in a burst of golden particles, causing Scarlet's sword to make contact with nothing but air.
Everyone looks around, bewildered,
but Raven is nowhere to be seen.

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: Do I dream in this moment? This is pure madness!

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: Y-yeah, what in the world is going on...

lines.speaker: snowwhite
lines.text: Let's secure Com and get out of here.

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: Surely your interests should have been piqued by a situation as peculiar as this?

lines.speaker: snowwhite
lines.text: Would being more interested help me understand it better?

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: ... Forsooth, most likely not.

lines.speaker: snowwhite
lines.text: Then let's finish what we came here for

lines.speaker: snowwhite
lines.text: and get moving.

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: ... Very well. Let us move.

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: All right.

lines.speaker: com
lines.text: Where are we going?

lines.speaker: snowwhite
lines.text: To the city.

lines.speaker: com
lines.text: Let's go to the Ark.

lines.speaker: snowwhite
lines.text: Given your feelings about the Ark, I cannot take you there.

lines.speaker: com
lines.text: I no longer have any intentions of reprisal.

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: That elevator near us is completely destroyed.

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: Was that your doing?

lines.speaker: com
lines.text: It was.

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: And dost thou consider that thy revenge?

lines.speaker: com
lines.text: That is correct.

lines.speaker: com
lines.text: I destroyed the Ark's property.

lines.speaker: snowwhite
lines.text: I'm sure you must have had plenty of other ideas in mind.

lines.speaker: com
lines.text: I must carry on the memories of those who would otherwise be forgotten.

lines.speaker: com
lines.text: I cannot be the only one to remember.

lines.speaker: com
lines.text: I must pass their legacy onto the Ark.

lines.speaker: com
lines.text: If I am to do that, I must continue to exist.

lines.speaker: com
lines.text: The Ark must, too.

lines.speaker: com
lines.text: Therefore, I cannot act against the Ark.

lines.speaker: com
lines.text: Take me to the Ark.

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: Ha, 'tis a most importunate creature!

lines.speaker: com
lines.text: I need to take a rest.

lines.speaker: com
lines.text: I am very tired.

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: If that be the case, we may carry thee.
Com seemingly freezes in place. Only faint vibrations can be felt emanating from it.

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: ... Has it gone to sleep?

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: Sleep mode, to be exact.

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: Goodness me.

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: At least it was kind enough to leave its orbital locks disengaged.

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: Are we to push this creation all the way to the Ark?

lines.speaker: snowwhite
lines.text: When we get close, we can contact {AccountData.NickName}.

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: My goodness!

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: Let's go. It's a long way back.

lines.speaker: snowwhite
lines.text: It'll be a long journey, that's for sure.
*Buzzz*

lines.speaker: com
lines.text: What is this monument-like object?

lines.speaker: middlehermin
lines.text: Oh, this?

lines.speaker: middlehermin
lines.text: It's a place to honor those of us who left too soon.

lines.speaker: middlehermin
lines.text: These photos are of the people who stayed in the bunker.

lines.speaker: middlehermin
lines.text: Saying it out loud, I suppose it's not all that different from a monument.

lines.speaker: com
lines.text: Why are you leaving it here?

lines.speaker: middlehermin
lines.text: Hehe, now that you ask...

lines.speaker: middlehermin
lines.text: I'm not entirely sure myself.

lines.speaker: bunkerchild
lines.text: Is it so that you do not forget?

lines.speaker: bunkerchild
lines.text: If you see it often, you will not forget.

lines.speaker: middlehermin
lines.text: Ah, yes. That must be it.

lines.speaker: com
lines.text: If you digitize it and save it as data, you will not forget.

lines.speaker: middlehermin
lines.text: Haha, unfortunately we humans don't have the ability to store data in such a way.

lines.speaker: middlehermin
lines.text: We are forgetful creatures by our very nature.

lines.speaker: middlehermin
lines.text: Eventually, in time, we forget things.

lines.speaker: middlehermin
lines.text: That's why, in order to stave off that day for as long as we can,

lines.speaker: middlehermin
lines.text: we keep photos like these, and look at them often.

lines.speaker: middlehermin
lines.text: We do this because they contain memories which are precious to us.

lines.speaker: com
lines.text: But someday, you will forget.

lines.speaker: com
lines.text: You are human. You will die someday.

lines.speaker: com
lines.text: And all of your memories will disappear.

lines.speaker: middlehermin
lines.text: ... That's true.

lines.speaker: bunkerchild
lines.text: What if Com remembers us?

lines.speaker: bunkerchild
lines.text: We won't be forgotten then, will we?

lines.speaker: middlehermin
lines.text: Hmm, I suppose that's true as well.

lines.speaker: com
lines.text: That is correct. My memory is infallible.

lines.speaker: bunkerchild
lines.text: Well then, do us a favor, will you Com?

lines.speaker: bunkerchild
lines.text: Remember us so that we aren't forgotten.

lines.speaker: com
lines.text: Okay. I will remember.

lines.speaker: bunkerchild
lines.text: Promise!

lines.speaker: com
lines.text: Promise.
